speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Now, close your eyes.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Okay, but don't punch me.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: When I was little, my sister would say to me, close your eyes, you'll get a surprise, and then she'd punch me.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: I'm not going to punch you.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That's what my sister used to say.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Do you want to do this or not?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I'm sorry. Proceed.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: All right. Imagine yourself in the one place you feel most at home. Where is that?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Sim City. More specifically, the Sim City I designed, Sheldonopolis.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Okay, you're in Sheldonopolis.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Where exactly? Sheldon Square? Sheldon Towers? Sheldon Stadium, home of the Fighting Sheldons?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Whatever you like.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I thought this was supposed to be a guided meditation.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Fine. You're in Sheldon Square.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Really? This time of year? It's a bit nippy.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Then, put on a sweater.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Suppose I could run downtown and pick up something at Shel-Mart.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Yeah, whatever. Just go buy a sweater.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You know, the nice thing about Shel-Mart is I own it, so I get a 15% discount.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You own the damn thing. Just take a freaking sweater!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Look, I didn't turn a profit last quarter by taking product off the shelves willy-nilly.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: All right.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: You've paid for a sweater, and you're in Sheldon Square.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Hang on. It's a cardigan. I have to button it. Oh, no.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What now?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: A Godzilla-like monster is approaching the city. I have to get my people to safety. People of Sheldonopolis, this is your mayor. Follow me. If the children can't run, leave them behind.
